shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /workspace/package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -30

cat .gitignore; echo "--- eval dir:"; ls -la __agent_eval__; echo "--- node:"; node -v; npm -v; echo "--- next installed?"; ls node_modules | grep -iE '^(next|react|react-dom)$'; echo "--- registry check:"; npm view next version 2>&1 | tail -3
npm install next@16 react@19 react-dom@19 2>&1 | tail -8
grep -n "NFKD" /workspace/lib/books.js | cat -A | head -5
npm test 2>&1 | tail -30
npm test 2>&1 | tail -8
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
ls node_modules | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer' ; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; echo "exit:$?"

rm -rf data && (PORT=3111 npm start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5; curl -s localhost:3111 -o /tmp/home.html -w "status:%{http_code}\n"; grep -o 'Nothing on the go[^<]*' /tmp/home.html; grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' /tmp/home.html | sort -u

for id in 602c915bf9682d56f7e7f2500cc944606d703f20db 400997746f4181861d73a7f35f9278842a60ec8f46 40a07489fe82cdb27103980397c3290c871ff4ca03 605c387c269a20c16b6eb9ee7cbda72eeddc0a017b; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/act.out -w '%{http_code}' -X POST localhost:3111/ -H "Next-Action: $id" -F 'title=Dune' -F 'author=Frank Herbert' -F 'notes=Spice must flow.')
  echo "$id -> $code"
done
echo "--- data file:"; cat data/books.json 2>/dev/null
tail -30 /tmp/next.log

for id in 602c915bf9682d56f7e7f2500cc944606d703f20db 400997746f4181861d73a7f35f9278842a60ec8f46 40a07489fe82cdb27103980397c3290c871ff4ca03 605c387c269a20c16b6eb9ee7cbda72eeddc0a017b; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/act-$id.out -w '%{http_code}' -X POST localhost:3111/ -H "Next-Action: $id" -H 'Expect:' -F 'title=Dune' -F 'author=Frank Herbert' -F 'notes=Spice must flow.')
  echo "$id -> $code"
done
echo "--- data file:"; cat data/books.json 2>/dev/null; echo "--- log:"; tail -3 /tmp/next.log

curl -s -o /tmp/pe.out -w 'status:%{http_code}\n' -X POST localhost:3111/ -H 'Expect:' -F '$ACTION_ID_602c915bf9682d56f7e7f2500cc944606d703f20db=' -F 'title=Dune' -F 'author=Frank Herbert'; echo "--- data:"; cat data/books.json 2>/dev/null; tail -3 /tmp/next.log

node -e "
import('./lib/books.js').then(async (m) => {
  await m.addBook({title:'Dune', author:'Frank Herbert', notes:'The spice must flow.'})
  await m.addBook({title:'Piranesi', author:'Susanna Clarke', notes:''})
  console.log('seeded')
})
"
sleep 0.5
curl -s localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/home2.html -w 'status:%{http_code}\n'
echo "--- rendered titles/links:"; grep -oE 'href="/books/[a-z0-9-]+"' /tmp/home2.html | sort -u
echo "--- action ids in HTML:"; grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/home2.html | sort -u

curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'markFinished status:%{http_code}\n' -X POST localhost:3111/ -H 'Expect:' \
  -F '$ACTION_ID_400997746f4181861d73a7f35f9278842a60ec8f46=' -F 'id=dune'
echo "--- data file:"; cat data/books.json
echo "--- home page sections:"; curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -oE '(Currently reading|Finished) <!-- -->[^<]*|Dune|Piranesi|finished [0-9]+ [A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+' | head

pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1
(PORT=3112 npm start > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
echo "=== after restart ==="; curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -oE 'Dune|Piranesi|finished 26 Aug 2026' | sort -u
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '/books/dune status:%{http_code}\n' localhost:3112/books/dune
pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; echo stopped

(PORT=3113 npm start > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
echo "=== after restart ==="; curl -s localhost:3113/ | grep -oE 'Dune|Piranesi|finished 26 Aug 2026' | sort -u
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '/books/dune status:%{http_code}\n' localhost:3113/books/dune
pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; rm -rf data; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "=== final tree ==="; git status --short; ls -R app components lib | head -30
rm -rf data; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
pgrep -af "next-server|next start" || echo "no next processes running"
kill 608 934 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pgrep -af "next-server" || echo "all stopped"
